rule: in light = any part of the solar disc above the terrain horizon (visible disc fraction > 0); dark otherwise. Each sample stands for one step (1 hour): longest darkness = longest run of consecutive dark samples x 1 h / 24; share in light = lit samples / all samples.
disc_model: pipeline/validation/vlib.py site_series: Sun as a disc of radius 695700 km seen from the observer (ground height from the lookup chain + 2 m), cut into 24 vertical strips, each compared with the horizon linearly interpolated between the 0.5 degree azimuths. Sun position: SPICE, Moon-centred MOON_ME, LT+S, then observer-relative.

with_patch.terrain: lookup chain with the web-encoded 20 m patch connecting-ridge, then web tiles L1, L0, whole-Moon map

without_patch.terrain: lookup chain without a patch: web tiles L1, L0, whole-Moon map
